EventTemplate: mod_jk child workerEnv in error state <*>
rationale: Explicit error state on a worker. Recurs constantly (539x) alongside startup -- worth surfacing as a persistent, unresolved issue rather than dismissing as routine.

EventTemplate: jk2_init() Can't find child <*> in scoreboard
